videos.title: Tesla Roadster: Nothing Catches It
videos.caption:
Stuck in traffic? Not anymore. 🚀

Gridlock, a police chase, even a hurricane… nothing catches it. 💨 No fire, just cold compressed-air thrusters lifting the Roadster over everything in its way.

Would you drive it? 👇
Comment where you'd fly first, and tag the friend who'd ride shotgun.

videos.title: Tesla Roadster: It Drove Upside Down
videos.caption: It drove UPSIDE DOWN... then it lifted off the ground. Tesla's new Roadster doesn't use fire. Fans suck it to the road, and SpaceX cold-gas thrusters blast pure compressed air to launch it. Tesla claims 0–60 in 0.81 seconds. #Tesla #Roadster #SpaceX #Engineering
